summary: Verified new Admin 'DJ Control' tab end-to-end. Backend endpoints powering the tab all pass (7/7 pytest). Frontend: tab renders with data-testid='dj-control-tab', header counts show on/live/off, on-shift and off-shift sections work, check-in expands panel with per-location buttons, POST /api/dj/checkin fires with correct location_slug and DJ card migrates to On Shift, karaoke toggle switches K:Off↔K:On with POST /api/karaoke/toggle/{slug}, checkout confirm dialog accepts and POST /api/dj/checkout/{id} fires. Regression: existing tabs (Dashboard, DJ Schedule, Gallery) still render.

test_results.tab_visibility: PASS — data-testid='tab-dj-control' present with label 'DJ Control'.
test_results.tab_render: PASS — clicking tab renders data-testid='dj-control-tab'. Header shows '0 on shift · 0 live · 90 off shift'.
test_results.off_shift_checkin_expand: PASS — dj-checkin-toggle-{id} expands dj-checkin-locations-{id} with 8 location buttons (dj-checkin-loc-{id}-{slug}).
test_results.checkin_api: PASS — clicking dj-checkin-loc-{id}-edgewood-atlanta fires POST /api/dj/checkin/{id}?location_slug=edgewood-atlanta and DJ card migrates to On Shift section (dj-checkout-{id} button appears).
test_results.karaoke_toggle: PASS — dj-toggle-karaoke-{id} label switches 'K: Off' → 'K: On' and POST /api/karaoke/toggle/edgewood-atlanta fires with {active,dj_id}.
test_results.stop_live_button: N/A (Mike not live) — data-testid='dj-force-end-live-{id}' correctly absent when no active LiveKit stream. Backend endpoint /api/livekit/stream/stop reachable (returns <500) per pytest.
test_results.checkout_flow: PASS — dj-checkout-{id} click surfaces window.confirm 'Check out DJ MIKE?'; dialog accepted; POST /api/dj/checkout fired (verified via subsequent GET /api/dj/profiles → current_location=null).
test_results.regression_tabs: PASS — tab-dashboard, tab-dj-schedule, tab-gallery all navigate without error.

critical_code_review_comments: DJControlTab.jsx uses window.location.origin instead of process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL for API calls — works in-cluster but inconsistent with codebase norms; recommend switching for consistency and testability against alternate backends.
Karaoke status is polled per location (N GETs on mount + every 15s). With 8 locations this is manageable, but a single aggregate /api/karaoke/status endpoint would reduce chatter.

checkOut() calls stream/stop before checkout when isLive(dj) — good — but does not await between them serially in a way that catches stream/stop failure; if stop fails, checkout still proceeds silently. Consider surfacing the stop error before checkout.
No admin-auth gating on the buttons themselves — DJControlTab trusts that AdminPage-level gate is active. Confirm parent route protection is enforced.
